paragraphs: I’ve spent nearly two decades navigating between brand identity, art direction, and visual design—currently leading creative projects at MUNclab and directing the creative studio Nampi Rupa-rupi Media (Narumi Visual) in Bandung. This multidisciplinary background, spanning graphic design, microstock ecosystem management, and audio-visual production, shapes a workflow that treats every project as a cohesive ecosystem rather than a mere compilation of static assets.

My design approach is rooted in structural thinking and efficient technical experimentation. When building the foundation of a new brand, my core principle is the integration of strategic logic and cross-medium exploration; merging conventional design tools with interactive visual instruments and generative artificial intelligence. Every visual identity must be built upon a precise narrative, systematically designed for scalability, and directly address core objectives without superficial ornamentation.

The “Smith1979” portfolio is driven by the intersection of sonic landscapes, nostalgia, and alternative culture. My background as a songwriter and composer—spanning post-rock, indiepop, tweepop, britpop, electronic, and ambient instrumentals—injects rhythm and emotional depth into my visual output. This sensibility is the primary differentiator; I do not merely design graphic compositions, but rather orchestrate multi-sensory experiences that fuse design aesthetics, local culture, and musical resonance.
